title: adenostyles alliariae var. kerneri
intro: Adenostyles alliariae var. kerneri, commonly known as Kern's oxtongue, is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe and protect wounds, as well as alleviate digestive issues and reduce fever. The therapeutic actions of Kern's oxtongue include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce spasms, and act as a diuretic, making it useful for treating conditions such as digestive disorders and urinary tract infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
